name: Vvuq4ai
description: Verify AI-generated STEM claims against curated knowledge bases, IEEE standards, and mathematical checks. VVUQ4AI runs physics constants, dimensional analysis, and standards compliance checks (IEEE 802.3, NSF Biosketch) on claims Claude generates or encounters, returning structured verdicts with confidence scores.
longDescription:
Ships **1 MCP server**, `vvuq`.

Installs with `claude plugin install vvuq4ai@claude-community` from `dirkenglund/vvuq4ai-plugin`.

Verify AI-generated STEM claims against curated knowledge bases, IEEE standards, and mathematical checks.

Verify AI-generated STEM claims against curated knowledge bases, IEEE standards, and mathematical checks. VVUQ4AI runs physics constants, dimensional analysis, and standards compliance checks (IEEE 802.3, NSF Biosketch) on claims Claude generates or encounters, returning structured verdicts with confidence scores.
